_what: The 48-hour campaign code referenced by campaign-01 and campaign-02. Minted from the HUB: Partners (/hub/owner/partners.html) -> create a code. This file is the exact request body for POST /api/hub/owner/partners.
_kind_note: kind:'campaign' is the shareable, no-partner code. evaluatePromo applies no binding and no self-referral check to it -- the only limits are expires_at and max_uses, which is what makes the deadline real rather than decorative.
_owner_decision: pct_off is the one number to reconsider. 10 matches every other discount in this codebase (the old customer-code default and the standard affiliate commission). 15 converts harder but comes straight out of food cost, and the real margin lives in pricing_config (food_cost_per_head, target_net_margin) which is not in git -- check it in HUB -> Pricing before going above 10.
_max_uses_note: null = unlimited. Set an integer if you want the scarcity to be real in units as well as in time -- the kitchen has a capacity ceiling and an unlimited code on a good day can write checks the prep list cannot cash.
